hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook for Uniswap v4 that routes swaps through Euler Protocol lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes quotes using a bonding-curve invariant, deposits input tokens into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from the opposite vault, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to handle all pool accounting. Vanilla concentrated-liquidity positions are blocked.
